data.narrative:
Electric Era is a Series A climate & energy company founded by Quincy Lee that has raised $11.5M to date. The valuation universe comprises one public comparable (LNZA) and eight private peers in Climate & Energy, including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix. However, the narrow peer set lacks sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables at similar valuation tiers to support a reliable peer-median approach.

The analysis applies stage-progression methodology, which is applicable given the company's Series A positioning. Using total capital raised ($11.5M) as a proxy baseline, a typical Series A-to-next-stage step-up multiplier of 2.0x yields an implied valuation of $23M. This method captures the expected value accretion between institutional funding rounds absent sufficient trading or late-stage transaction data in the immediate peer cohort.

The triangulated range is $20M to $26M, with a median of $23M. This estimate rests on a single applicable methodology, creating meaningful uncertainty. Key limitations include the absence of granular peer comparables at Electric Era's exact stage and capital position, limiting cross-validation. Investors should treat this range as a floor pending additional market data or near-term financial performance indicators that would enable revenue or margin-based approaches.
